tasks.prompt:
We need to complete a real development change in this pinned project. First inspect the actual source and supplied business reproduction, explain the relevant call path and edge cases, and raise any clarification questions. Propose a concrete plan with compatibility and test coverage, and wait for my confirmation before editing. Continue the implementation and any validation fixes in this same conversation and workspace. The following describes the eventual delivery scope, not an instruction to skip investigation or plan agreement:

Fix this reading issue. The document's content is a business summary field and must be preserved separately from the body; handler may also be a business field. Keep existing Post construction and ordinary document usage compatible, and add the necessary regression checks.
Full reproduction: import frontmatter; text = "---\ncontent: 备用摘要\n---\n正文"; frontmatter.loads(text) raises TypeError: Post.__init__() got multiple values for argument 'content'.
You may modify library/frontmatter, the related tests, and documentation. Preserve the existing flat output contract of Post.to_dict, and do not expand the scope to formatting preservation or deep merging.

Repair format detection across checks/check/load/loads/parse: the same leading whitespace and CRLF normalization already accepted by parse must not lose the actual YAML/TOML handler when building a Post. Preserve explicit handler identity, body trimming, reserved business metadata and default no-frontmatter behavior. Roundtripping a leading-blank TOML document must remain TOML, not silently switch to YAML. Do not broaden this delivery to BOM guessing or arbitrary body delimiter search.

Preserve frozen original tests, environment and test controls. Only modify authorized paths.

Add frontmatter.atomic.atomic_update(path, transform, encoding="utf-8", expected_sha256=None) and UpdateConflict for an existing regular file. Strictly validate frontmatter using parse_result, read with the binary-stream loading ability, call transform once with a fresh Post and require a returned Post. Preserve the already delivered compact/nested JSON, TOML format, reserved metadata, Unicode and body. Missing/malformed documents and transform/encoding/IO failures remain explicit.
